dataset_metadata.source: NYC Open Data (NYC DOT Street Closures u2e5-msge) & 511NY Incident Feeds

dataset_metadata.description: Curated authentic urban disruption scenarios mapping real NYC street closures, water main bursts, arterial traffic accidents, and hospital emergency alerts to the Manhattan road topology.

scenarios.title: Scheduled Utility Resurfacing on Central Park South
text_alerts: ℹ️ NYC DOT TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Central Park South between Columbus Circle (M01) and 5th Avenue (M02) is closed to vehicular traffic due to scheduled resurfacing. Detour via W 58th St.

scenarios.title: Subterranean Water Main Rupture on 5th Avenue

⚠️ 511NY TRAFFIC BOTTLENECK: Severe gridlock along Broadway between Times Square (M10) and Herald Square (M17). Speeds reduced to crawl; travel time increased 3.2× normal.
